# rf44 3-Phase BLDC Motor Controller - Logical Netlist

## Netlist Summary

This document provides the complete logical netlist for the rf44 10kW BLDC motor controller. The design uses three IR2101 bootstrap gate drivers (one per phase) to drive six IRFS7530TRL7PP DirectFET MOSFETs in a 3-phase bridge configuration. The STM32F405RGT6 provides FOC control with three INA240A1PW current sense amplifiers providing bidirectional phase current measurement.
